article.title: Creatify Max串接廣告研究、素材與推出審批
article.title_en: Creatify Max connects ad research, creative and launch approvals
article.summary: Creatify推出Max，讓團隊從競品研究、素材製作到活動草擬，在Creatify或Slack內處理。
article.summary_en: Creatify launched Max for competitor research, creative production and campaign drafting inside Creatify or Slack.
highlights: 推出、預算及暫停建議會以批准卡呈現；個別例行工作可另行授權自動執行。
Slack支援排程報表，以及在討論串批准或拒絕建議。
highlights_en: Launch, budget and pause proposals arrive as approval cards; a trusted routine can be separately authorized to act autonomously.
Slack supports scheduled reports and approval or dismissal of proposals in threads.
article.why: 創意與媒體操作由同一代理銜接，投放團隊可決定哪些建議需逐次審閱，哪些固定檢查適合設成例行工作。
article.why_en: Media teams can decide which proposals need repeated review and which fixed checks fit a scheduled routine.
article.next_step: 選一組預算調整建議，核對批准卡的金額、活動及批准人紀錄，再界定是否授權任何單一例行工作。
article.next_step_en: Reconcile campaign names, amounts and approver records on a budget-change card before authorizing any individual routine.
article.detail: Max可由商品連結、簡報或媒體計劃草擬活動，並沿用命名、預算及定向規則。公司亦列出競品廣告研究與素材生成能力。團隊可先追查一項研究發現如何轉成素材和活動設定，核對批准卡能否完整交代變更，再決定如何分配代理與人員的操作責任。這些是公司公布的工作流程。
article.detail_en: Max drafts campaigns from product links, briefs or media plans using naming, budget and targeting rules. Trace a research finding into creative and campaign settings, then check that the approval card explains the changes before assigning operating responsibilities.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
